explication: autobrr automates early torrent and Usenet downloads. A user configures indexers, feeds, filters, actions, and clients through the web interface; IRC announces and scheduled feeds provide releases, which are filtered and then sent through configured actions to download clients or *arr applications. Separate capabilities include lists, notifications, authentication, and persistent configuration. Startup wiring is visible, but several service-to-service details and API route calls were not sampled; those links are included only where the README documents them.
